limitations: Previously inspected full export; site split is analytical separation, not blindness.
Unrecorded phases, styles and provenance may confound within-site comparisons.
Identical-text weighting does not establish independent dies or artifacts.
Exclusion of damaged/multiline/ambiguous rows may select nonrepresentatively.
Failure is not evidence that inscriptions do not name emblems. No global power claim without a justified alternative.
numerical_tie_allowance: absolute 1e-12 in Z units for >= comparisons
quality_rule: Every in-scope row of a fully eligible artifact must be Good or Fair; regroup families afterward.
success_scope: A reproducible site-transfer association under these sampling/model assumptions only. It may prioritize at most5 primary motif/sign checks, never establish a motif-linked semantic function by itself.
